gitCommit.subject: feat(TSK-4815): admin generation failure error disclosure (#1648)
gitCommit.body:
feat(TSK-4815): admin generation failure error disclosure (#1648)

* feat(TSK-4815): show translated failure reason in admin image details

Help admins diagnose failed generations by surfacing localized error messages in the image management detail panel.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

* feat(TSK-4815): align admin and frontend generation error disclosure

Show translated or raw errors on admin image/video cards, and keep frontend text gallery failures localized with type-specific fallbacks.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

* feat(TSK-4815): map provider generation errors to translated user messages

Add shared mappers for FAL, RunPod API, and webhook failures so admin and
frontend surfaces show localized copy instead of raw provider strings.
Split image/video mappings, add parameterized templates for limits and
ranges, store cleaner webhook errors, and add admin video status filtering.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

* fix(TSK-4815): harden generation error mapping after code review

Route stable error IDs through formatMappedGenerationError so parameterized
messages interpolate correctly in admin, frontend, and AI tool toasts.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

---------

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>
